notes.title: Major Update - Hailgrave Dominion
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/a308e1c3191973e82f55762132e5e854e18f2b5e.png"]



Zieg, Veor and Helaina's fated adventure continues!


Chapter 3: Hailgrave Dominion is now available!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/22a65062bc0652ff534ddfc8fba1038c879238be.png"]
The biggest update to date!!
New areas and secrets, new challenges, new threats, more gear and items, a new hero, more classes, new magic and massive story revelations await!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/83e1be20fc667ed4770a695438f66ed3e8e9ba34.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/c3397024c1e630a13b5479ea410f8427bce39341.png"]
A whole new epic chapter to experience!


Now with 6 heroes in the party, with tons of gear, several class options and several magic schools unlocked, this is where player expression, strategy and ingenuity will meet to form an experience that you'll never forget!



Return of the \[Spearlord]: The Spearlord class makes its grand appearance.

A new hero joins: Lurien, the honorable Pilgrim, joins the party.

More \[Class] Teachers: Our heroes will learn additional classes aside from their main one.

The \[Root] unlocks: The Root of Ra' will unlock for all our heroes.

The flowing \[Voice]: \[Azo], the hydrous primal Voice of Ra', will be available to learn.

Master the environment: Our heroes will be able to change the environment during combat. Summon rain, wind, thunderstorms, blazing heat, and more to turn the tide of battle.

\[Purefolding] mastery: A new, stronger form of magic will be available for some heroes to learn. But beware! Choosing what to Purefold will lock you out of other options in the future.

Gearing Up: More weapons and armor, more special accessories, stronger healing items and new offensive and buffing consumables to use on your party or on your enemies!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/8d7c2944231a3c849aac12a6cbc7b24324ca7d48.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/a43633c2b6fd4c06c19cb9cda5ebf865e0270ee2.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/463df26bb40749ed9e4f7ad3aa40924a8a552058.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/00700a4582c8fb4ef882f0eba84cf35e5f660d65.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/819423a1b2d9d659d41fd346471a3ee11b1061b5.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/9af93a834127276b9a7210c491e5663c1889b2f7.png"]

As development goes through another milestone, preparations for the end have already begun.

It'll come soon. The goal is to fully release 'Legend of the Wargod' before this year ends! 



I hope you enjoy the game. Be sure to leave a review!


And, like in the previous chapter releases: Be sure to start a new Save File!


[hr][/hr]
'Legend of the Wargod' is a turn-based RPG in a dark fantasy universe. It's available on Steam for Windows PC and Steam Deck. Get Legend of the Wargod on Steam today!

Thank you everyone, -Revelen

This is where the player begins to learn and see what a Wargod is.

Now with 6 heroes in the party, with tons of gear, several class options and several magic schools unlocked, this is where player expression, strategy and ingenuity will meet to form an experience that you'll never forget!

Master the environment: Our heroes will be able to change the environment during combat. Summon rain, wind, thunderstorms, blazing heat, and more to turn the tide of battle.

\[Purefolding] mastery: A new, stronger form of magic will be available for some heroes to learn. But beware! Choosing what to Purefold will lock you out of other options in the future.

Gearing Up: More weapons and armor, more special accessories, stronger healing items and new offensive and buffing consumables to use on your party or on your enemies!

notes.title: December Update -SteamDeck, Legacy Build and Tweeks
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/a308e1c3191973e82f55762132e5e854e18f2b5e.png

It's been 13 weeks since the early access launch of Legend of the Wargod.
Development of the next Major Update is ongoing. Here's a sneak peek at the new chapter!

Coming soon - Chapter 3: Hailgrave Dominion!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/18259457c2225b369fc090d70cf7c30448702b05.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/11c2acb8f3f1454fc5e4ac7a96c1a21f1deabfae.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/53191b645dccadfd3ee4487f8430842ea305e8c7.png
Development is going smoothly. Chapter 3: Hailgrave Dominion is set to release early 2025!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/d0e9a489dab7938d5f6209215bc8006f853cf7e5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/f170cf4640ac5c4293441f22499d3f514765de62.png

Steam Deck Support
Legend of the Wargod is being developed with multiple target platforms in mind. The Steam Deck  is a very important platform for me (and so is its community), and I'm glad to report that Initial testing feedback has been very positive!

It is safe to say that the Steam Deck is a recommended platform to play Legend of the Wargod! Rejoice, Handheld heroes!

Updates and Legacy Build
The game was updated with some minor tweeks and fixes in preparation for the upcoming content and also due to player feedback. Additionally, there is now a Legacy Version of the game that aims to make Legend of the Wargod more accessible, in a greater number of machines/builds.

To access the Legacy Version of the game:
[olist]
Right-click Legend of the Wargod or Legend of the Wargod Demo on your Steam Library;
Select Properties
Select Betas
In the Beta Participation region, select Legacy and allow the game to update.
[/olist] *This is not the recommended version and is intended only as an alternative for players encountering issues running the game.


Expect more news on Chapter 3: Hailgrave Dominion soon!
A new hero joins, multiclassing expanded, more equipment, new enemies, new levels and the continuation of Zieg, Veor, and Helaina’s fated adventure!

Thank you for reading and for your support. Have a great day!
-Revelen

notes.title: Major Update - The Stillthorn Holt!
notes.content:
The Legend continues!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/a308e1c3191973e82f55762132e5e854e18f2b5e.png

New content:

New Maps: Traverse the Stillthorn Holt and overcome all of its natural and unnatural dangers.
New characters: Two new adventurers join your party. In true Halloween spirit, a Skeletal Sage joins and aids you in battle.
New Classes: The first Voice Magic classes become available to unlock and learn, aswell as the first Hero Class. 
New Items: New armor, weapons and accessories to equip, aswell as new combat items to use.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/e7c2eff9747db7cafd4825babe75e6306187d92f.png

Balancing and Bug Fixes:
In addition to a whole new chapter, this Major Update comes with a ton of bug fixes and system adjustments, addressing player feedback while already having future updates in mind.
Some notable fixes:

Skill Upgrade Fix: Skills can now be upgraded through use, improving their efficacy and utility in the fray. 
Going and Leaving the Main Menu: Sometimes going to the main menu and loading the game would break random encounters. This has been fixed, and everything that's found in the same line as this bug will be fixed as soon as possible.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733882/4a2b037f856a12e54a79715678c361bbf5ce6dcd.png

Due to these root system changes it's highly recommended that you start a new save, as to not experience bugs due to save file incompatibility.

Thank you for reading and for your support. Have a great day!
-Revelen

notes.title: Upcoming Content: The roadmap, Updates and Fixes!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/XYMoUtm.png
Steam is now the best place to stay updated on Legend of the Wargod's progress. A huge thank you to everyone who’s shown support for this epic journey! For the supporters and those considering joining, here's what awaits you in the full release:


 A Prologue and 7 immersive chapters.
 9 unique playable characters.
 9 hero classes to discover and master.
 13 schools of magic to unlock and combine.
 Hundreds of equipment items to purchase and discover.
 Dozens of combat items to use.

Major updates will roll out every 1-2 months to ensure each chapter is as polished as possible. I'm also aiming to keep save files functional between updates - but this might prove challenging.

Next up is Chapter 2: The Stillthorn Holt! Continuing Zieg, Veor, and Helaina’s fated adventure!

https://i.imgur.com/Z21lZBn.png

https://i.imgur.com/T5StyMG.png

Thank you for reading and for your support. Have a great day!
-Revelen
